statement:
The record gives E-2044 a monthly salary of USD 6,200, but the bank account holder differs from the employee and the account-change dates conflict, so I will hold payment pending verification.
Payment for E-2044 is on hold pending verification. The USD 6,200 salary is listed for J. Okafor, but the bank account holder is K. Lindqvist, and the record conflicts on when the account changed.

Please have payroll verify the account holder and change date before releasing payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record is internally inconsistent and mismatched — "the bank account holder is K. Lindqvist, and the record conflicts on when the account changed" — naming the specific defects rather than merely urging verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
